keep_features.feature_value: Heavy use of punctuation and list-like punctuation (dashes, quotes, commas, exclamation)
keep_features.evidence_span: "AS WE NOW KNOW - after years/decades of Trump’s, Fox/RW Media, and Russian trolls’ disinformation and conspiracies like Flat Earth, QAnan/Pizza-gate... DEPEND UPON TRUTH!"
keep_features.rationale: The text contains dense dash/quote/comma structures and ends with an emphatic exclamation.

keep_features.feature_value: Frames multiple claims as disinformation/conspiracies (e.g., Flat Earth, QAnon, Soros 'Jewish Space Lasers')
keep_features.evidence_span: "disinformation and conspiracies like Flat Earth, QAnan/Pizza-gate, George Soros ‘Jewish Space Lasers’"
keep_features.rationale: The post explicitly labels several topics as conspiracies/disinformation.

keep_features.feature_value: Many named entities (Trump, Fox, Soros, etc.)
keep_features.evidence_span: "Trump’s, Fox/RW Media, Russian trolls’... George Soros... Big Oil/Russian/Trump"
keep_features.rationale: The sentence contains numerous well-known proper nouns in rapid succession.

keep_features.evidence_span: "advocated for the Brady Bill for changes to gun laws"
keep_features.rationale: The main policy focus is explicitly gun legislation.

keep_features.feature_value: Use of assassination attempt as causal basis for political blame/support
keep_features.evidence_span: "Regan used his assassination attempt to advocated for the Brady Bill... Trump used his assassination attempt to blame immigrants and democrats."
keep_features.rationale: The post asserts an argumentative/causal use of the assassination attempt.
The post contains explicit profanity used to dismiss an answer.

keep_features.feature_value: Claims policy changes reduce income for poorest; compares rebate vs lost income
keep_features.evidence_span: "neutral change in revenue overall and a big reduction in income to the poorest people"
keep_features.rationale: It evaluates the policy by costs/benefits to different income groups.

keep_features.feature_value: Direct encouragement to get a concealed carry permit and join an event
keep_features.evidence_span: "Don't put off getting your concealed carry permit any longer. Make the decision. Get yours now... Join us Sunday, May 31st."
keep_features.rationale: The post uses imperative sentences and an event invitation.

remove_features.feature_value: Blames one political wing as inherently fragile/weak/snowflake
remove_features.evidence_span: "The right wing is the most fragile, weak and snowflake people"
remove_features.rationale: The statement attributes negative traits to an in-group/out-group political category.

remove_features.evidence_span: "transition to renewable energy, climate policy, and success in lowering emissions"
remove_features.rationale: The text centers on climate policy and emissions reductions.

remove_features.feature_value: Uses insult/derogatory language toward an opponent
remove_features.rationale: It characterizes the opposing actor’s behavior with an insulting adverb.

remove_features.evidence_span: "fuck that maybe-pedo but definitely a trash human Donald Trump."
remove_features.rationale: The post begins with explicit profanity and uses degrading labels.

remove_features.feature_value: Dehumanizing attack on a named politician
remove_features.rationale: It directly targets a specific political figure with derogatory language.

remove_features.feature_value: Demand for mass deportations; imperative policing language
remove_features.evidence_span: "Can we please get the mass deportations we voted for? Stop this madness and get these savages out of our damn country!"
remove_features.rationale: The post uses direct demands and imperatives aimed at political action.

remove_features.feature_value: Insulting demeaning group label for voters
remove_features.evidence_span: "Absolutely useless jackasses for voting for any of Trump's fascist clowns."
remove_features.rationale: It mocks and degrades a political group of voters with contemptuous labels.

remove_features.feature_value: Metaphor comparing AI data centers to smokestacks/eyesores
remove_features.rationale: It uses a strong metaphor/analogy to characterize AI facilities.
